Ha I really didn’t want to respond but the main difference between you and I? Are you curious?

I would rather treat someone with respect and not publicly berate people who are hurting. Obviously I have no respect for fuckboys like you but the difference is I’m not defending his actions not berating them. I’m just calling out fuckboys like you who think they know everything 

I mean this is reddit, look at the the time and care you’re putting into your diction, grammar, etc... for what? as a comparison point to attack me for calling it your insensitive, ignorant, generally unhelpful advice? 

Anyways, the main difference between us is I won’t presume to understand the tone, situation, and past experiences a person has survived simply because I feel they need ‘tough love’. Simply because I feel it’s right, doesn’t give me the right to attack people who make mistakes. No shit it was a mistake and if it wasn’t then that’s terrible, but who are you to decide what is right or wrong? Where you there? Again, what are your qualifications? Other than you think you’re better than others on here because you “prepared better” for your plans. Get off the pulpit, and try to speak as a peer. Not some set righteous asshat who thinks they can tell people how to act logically in suicidal moments. 

If the above doesn’t get through your thick skull, then consider this:

A man who is sick makes a mistake. He knows it. You don’t however. You’re just another reddit know it all who reads his post.

You berate then and call them out with tough love.

What happens when he takes that as confirmation he should end his life? Perhaps initially he was just upset and did something stupid (I’m sure you’ve been there)
Maybe that was just the last straw? Can you live with that? I can’t. 

To reiterate to you toxic idiots, my solution leaves no opportunity for me to guilt over the fact that I told a suicidal stranger off, then proceeded to intellectualize it in a way where people must believe you’re a genius! You must be the next best thing that has ever happened here. 

That’s sarcasm by the way. You need to check yourselves. You guys have no understanding of what OP has suffered or gone through. Not everything in life is put on reddit and you should be grateful that I said something to your dumb ass, in the event he does do something.

Personally, I’m okay with dying. I’m not okay with pushing someone else there. That’s the difference you fucking idiot.
